blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound provides valuable volumetric context for anatomical assessment, motivating reconstruction from widely available two-dimensional (2D) slices. Sparse slices leave much of the volume unobserved, even when their acquisition poses are known. Existing methods interpolate observed intensities or incorporate learned 2D image features into 3D reconstruction, but their complementary roles in predicting smooth structure and residual details remain less explored. We introduce XFreq, a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction. It uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations, complementing splatted intensities and sampling geometry. A low-frequency decoder predicts a smooth 3D field from the splat representation, while a high-frequency decoder additionally incorporates the queried 2D features to predict residual details. A learned gating module regulates the residual contribution based on geometry and cross-slice feature variation. We evaluate XFreq on an in-house fetal brain dataset and the public CETUS cardiac dataset, using slices resampled from 3D ultrasound volumes and fivefold cross-validation. Among the compared methods, XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM in most settings across both datasets, reaching 26.82 dB PSNR on CETUS with 32 input slices. Ablation studies further show the contributions of local feature querying, geometric cues, and residual prediction, with gains generally increasing as more input slices are used. Our findings highlight the value of geometry-aligned cross-view feature integration for reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D slices.

Sparse切片使大部分体积无法观察,即使其获取姿势已知. 现有方法内插观察到的强度或将学到的二维图像特征纳入三维重建,但它们在预测平滑结构和剩余细节方面的互补作用仍然较少探索. 我们介绍XFreq,一个几何结构框架,用于稀少的3D超声波重建. 它使用已知的切片姿势和有限的足迹来查询3D位置的2D图像特征,以补充镀层强度和采样几何. 低频解码器会从浮标表示中预测一个光滑的3D字段,而高频解码器会额外融入被询问的2D特性来预测剩余细节. 一个学习的格子模块根据几何学和交叉切片特征变异来调节剩余的贡献. 我们在内部胎儿脑数据集和公共CETUS心脏数据集上评价XFreq,使用从3D超声波卷和5倍交叉验证重印的切片. 在比较方法中,XFreq在两个数据集的大多数设置中实现了最高的PSNR和SSIM,在CETUS上达到了26.82 dB PSNR,输入片32个. 校准研究进一步显示局部特征查询、几何提示和剩余预测的贡献,随着使用更多的输入片段,收益一般会增加。 我们的研究结果突出了几何-对齐的交叉视图特征集成对于从稀疏的2D片重建3D超声波卷的价值.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Ultrasound is widely used in clinical practice, including obstetric, abdominal, and cardiac imaging, because of its affordability, accessibility, and real-time imaging capabilities.
Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound further provides volumetric anatomical information, enabling examination from different orientations and retrospective selection of imaging planes [ 43 ] .
As two-dimensional (2D) B-mode ultrasound remains more widely available, reconstructing 3D volumes from sparse 2D slices offers a potential alternative to dedicated 3D acquisition [ 17 ] .
Standard ultrasound planes are identified by anatomical landmarks, providing spatial cues about the expected relative positions and orientations of 2D views [ 4 , 9 , 31 ] .
We focus on reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D observations with known slice poses.
Traditional methods map observed slice intensities into 3D using known spatial geometry and interpolate unobserved regions [ 16 , 34 ] .
Neural implicit and Gaussian representations provide more flexible volumetric models, often optimized separately for each set of input 2D slices [ 41 , 12 , 13 , 1 , 28 ] .
Supervised reconstruction methods instead learn common spatial patterns from training data, allowing features extracted from sparse 2D images to guide the prediction of unobserved 3D regions [ 22 , 23 , 36 ] .
Despite these advances, reconstructing unobserved 3D regions from sparse slices remains challenging [ 32 , 39 ] , particularly when using learned image features while maintaining consistency with observed slice intensities (Fig. 1 ).

blocks.en:
We introduce XFreq , a geometry-aligned cross-view reconstruction framework that assigns complementary roles to observed intensities and learned image features.
Rather than directly mixing these inputs, XFreq predicts smooth volumetric content from splatted observations and uses pose-aligned image features from multiple slices to infer residual details.
The smooth field and residual are then combined adaptively, followed by a data consistency correction to preserve the observed slice intensities.
To evaluate XFreq across different anatomies and sampling densities, we conduct experiments on fetal brain and cardiac ultrasound datasets using 8, 16, and 32 input slices.
XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM in most settings among classical, volumetric fitting, and supervised reconstruction methods.
Ablation and spatial analyses further show that the gains from queried image features vary with sampling density and distance to the observed slices.
These findings show that the value of learned image features depends not only on what they encode, but also on how they are spatially aligned with the observed slices.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We develop a local feature querying mechanism that projects 3D locations onto 2D slices, selects slices based on spatial proximity, and aggregates image features using geometry-conditioned weights. • We design an asymmetric architecture that predicts a smooth 3D field from splatted intensities and geometry, while incorporating image features into a gated high-frequency residual branch to recover spatial details. • We evaluate XFreq on two ultrasound datasets using fivefold cross-validation.
The results demonstrate the benefits of local feature querying and slice geometry, with queried features providing larger gains near observed slices.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work on 3D reconstruction spans classical interpolation, volumetric fitting, and supervised reconstruction.
We review volumetric fitting and learning-based reconstruction, followed by geometric and multiscale techniques for integrating spatial information.
blocks.zh:
3D重建的前期工作跨越了古典插图、体积装配以及监督重建。
我们审查体积配置和以学习为基础的重建,然后是几何和多尺度的空间信息整合技术。

blocks.en:
Reconstruction from freehand ultrasound can require estimating unknown slice poses [ 10 ] .
RecON [ 26 ] estimates scan trajectories, while ImplicitVol [ 41 ] jointly refines slice poses and fits a continuous intensity field.
Building on implicit volume fitting, RapidVol [ 12 ] reduces reconstruction time through factorized volumetric representations.
More recently, 3D Gaussian representations have attracted attention for their explicit spatial parameterization and efficient differentiable rendering [ 19 ] .
UltraGauss [ 13 ] models the interaction between acquisition slices and 3D Gaussians, while BIGUS [ 1 ] and UltraG-Ray [ 11 ] incorporate ultrasound-specific scattering and ray-based acoustic effects.
GaussianPile [ 21 ] further accounts for finite slice thickness in Gaussian-based volumetric reconstruction.
Although these approaches differ in their volumetric representations and image formation models, most optimize a separate 3D representation for each set of input slices, rather than learning a shared reconstruction model from a collection of training volumes.
blocks.zh:
通过自由手超声波进行重建可能需要估计未知的切片构成[10].
RecON [26] 估计扫描轨迹,而Implicit Vol [41] 联合改进了切片姿势并适合一个连续的强度场.
在隐性体积装配的基础上,RapidVol[12]通过将体积表示要素化来缩短重建时间.
最近,3D高斯表示法因其明确的空间参数化和高效的可分异渲染[19]而引起人们的注意.
UltraGauss [13] 模拟获取切片与3D高斯人之间的相互作用,而BIGUS [1]和UltraG-Ray [11] 则包含超声特异性的散射和以射线为基础的声学效果.
GaussianPile [21] 进一步计算出高斯基于量子重建的有限切片厚度.
虽然这些方法在音量表达和图像形成模型上有所不同,但大多数优化了每组输入片的单独3D表达,而不是从所收集的训练卷中学习出一个共享的重建模型.

blocks.en:
Learning-based approaches learn a shared reconstruction model from training data to predict 3D volumes from sparse 2D inputs [ 18 , 6 ] .
Normalized convolution [ 20 ] and learned confidence propagation [ 14 ] address sparse observations through confidence-aware processing, while 3D U-Net [ 8 ] provides a general architecture for volumetric feature learning.
Learning-based 3D reconstruction in medical imaging includes different prediction targets, ranging from volumetric intensity to anatomical shape [ 7 , 42 , 35 ] .
DIF-Net [ 22 ] predicts a continuous 3D intensity field from sparse CBCT projections using learned image features, whereas E-Pix2Vox++ [ 37 ] reconstructs 3D cardiac anatomy from multiple 2D ultrasound views.
These studies demonstrate that learned 2D image features can be geometrically aligned and aggregated to guide the reconstruction of unobserved 3D regions [ 30 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh:
基于学习的方法从培训数据中学习到一个共同的重建模型,从稀少的2D投入中预测出3D卷[18,6].
常态化的演化[20]和所学出的信心传播[14]通过信心感知处理来处理稀少的观察,而3D U-Net[8]则为量子特征学习提供了一般架构.
医学成像中基于学习的立体重建包括不同的预测目标,从体积强度到解剖形状[7,42,35].
DIF-Net [22]利用所学的图像特性,从CBCT的稀疏预测中预测出一个连续的3D强度场,而E-Pix2Vox++ [37]则从多位2D超声波视角重建出3D心脏解剖.
这些研究表明,学到的二维图像特征可以几何对接并汇总,以指导未观测到的三维区域的重建[30,40].

blocks.en:
Recent methods explore feature consistency and geometric priors to improve 3D reconstruction from sparse slices [ 15 , 44 ] .
FineRecon [ 36 ] combines depth guidance with high-resolution 2D image features to refine coarse 3D predictions.
C 2 RV [ 23 ] combines multiscale volumetric representations with cross-view attention to enhance feature interactions across spatial regions and views.
MS3D [ 25 ] employs hierarchical multiscale representations to model global structures and local details at different resolutions.
Low-pass filtering and residual decomposition provide a signal processing basis for separating smooth components from fine spatial variations [ 27 ] .
Beyond spatial detail recovery, maintaining consistency with acquired observations is another essential aspect of reconstruction [ 24 , 38 ] .
MoDL [ 2 ] combines learned regularization with explicit data consistency constraints in an iterative reconstruction scheme.
These studies advance both spatial detail recovery and observation consistency, providing a foundation for integrating geometry-aligned image features with directly observed slice intensities in 3D ultrasound reconstruction.

最近的方法探索了特征一致性和几何前缀,从稀有的切片来改进3D重建[15,44].
FineRecon [36] 将深度向导与高分辨度的2D图像特性相结合来完善粗细的3D预测.
C 2 RV [23] 结合了多尺度的量子表达和交叉视图关注,以加强跨空间区域和观点的地物相互作用.
MS3D[25]采用分级的多比例代表制,以模型化全球结构和不同分辨率的地方细节.
低通滤取和残留分解为将平滑组件与细空间变异相分离提供了信号处理基础 [27].
除了空间细节恢复之外,与获得的观测保持一致是重建的另一个重要方面[24、38]。
MODL[2]在迭代重建计划中将所学的规范化与明确的数据一致性限制结合起来.
这些研究推进了空间细节恢复和观测一致性,为将几何相通的图像特征与3D超声波重建中直接观察到的切片强度相融合奠定了基础.

As illustrated in Fig. 2 , XFreq combines observation encoding and geometry-aligned feature querying for frequency-selective 3D reconstruction.
Splatted slice intensities, sampling coverage, and pose-derived geometry are processed by a shared 3D encoder to obtain multiscale features 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} .
In parallel, a 2D encoder extracts image features from the input slices.
Using known slice poses, XFreq projects each 3D query location onto the slices and aggregates the sampled features into a 3D feature volume Φ \Phi .
The low-frequency decoder predicts a smooth 3D field from 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} , while the high-frequency decoder incorporates both 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} and Φ \Phi to predict residual details.
A learned gate conditioned on sampling geometry and cross-view feature variation modulates the residual before its combination with the smooth prediction, followed by a data consistency correction to produce the final 3D ultrasound volume V ^ \widehat{V} .

blocks.en:
We evaluate XFreq on the in-house FetalBrain dataset (30 volumes from 29 patients) and the public CETUS [ 3 ] dataset (90 cardiac volumes from 45 patients).
The in-house study received institutional review board approval.
For both datasets, we generate paired 2D observations and 3D reconstruction targets from each preprocessed 160 3 160^{3} volume with a nominal voxel spacing of 0.6 mm.
Specifically, we sample N ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 } N\in\{8,16,32\} 2D slices of size 64 2 64^{2} at known poses with 1.5 mm in-plane spacing, and downsample the source volume to 80 3 80^{3} with 1.2 mm spacing as the reconstruction target V gt V_{\mathrm{gt}} to reduce computational cost.

我们在内部FetalBrain数据集(29个病人的30卷)和公共CETUS[3]数据集(45个病人的90个心脏卷)上评价了XFreq.
内部研究得到了机构审查委员会的批准。
对于两个数据集,我们从每个预处理的160 3 160^{3}的体积中生成配对的2D观测和3D重建目标,标定的阴道间距为0.6毫米.
具体来说,我们用已知的平面相距为1.5毫米的姿势对N { { 8, 16, 32} N\in { 8, 16, 32} 2D 切片尺寸为64, 2 642} 进行取样, 将源量取样到 80 3 80 * }, 以1.2 mm 的相距作为重建目标 V gt V_{\ mathrm{gt} 以减少计算成本。

We compare XFreq with three categories of reconstruction methods.
Traditional methods include nearest-neighbor interpolation, harmonic inpainting, and normalized convolution [ 20 ] .
Volumetric fitting methods include SIREN [ 33 ] , ImplicitVol-FP [ 41 ] , HashGrid [ 29 ] , TriPlane [ 5 ] , BIGUS [ 1 ] , and UltraGauss [ 13 ] .
Learning-based methods trained across patients include NConv-CNN-3D [ 14 ] , DIF-Net-US [ 22 ] , and C 2 RV-US [ 23 ] , which are adapted to the same 3D ultrasound reconstruction task.
All learning-based methods are trained using the same random seed and evaluated with a shared, frozen data consistency correction.

blocks.en:
We implement XFreq in PyTorch and train it on NVIDIA L40S GPUs with 48 GB memory.
Training uses full 80 3 80^{3} volumes, with one patient sampled per optimization step and losses averaged across that patient’s volumes.
We train for 12,000 iterations per fold using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and cosine learning rate decay, alternating among N = 8 , 16 , 32 N=8,16,32 input slices.
For each fold, we select the checkpoint with the highest mean PSNR on an inner validation set (20% of the training patients), excluding the test fold.
Additional hyperparameter settings, slice-pose sampling protocols, and data-consistency settings are provided in the supplementary material.

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents the reconstruction results of XFreq and representative classical, per-volume fitting, and supervised methods on FetalBrain and CETUS .
XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and 3D SSIM in most evaluation settings, demonstrating strong reconstruction performance across anatomical structures and sampling densities.
On CETUS with N = 8 N=8 , C 2 RV-US slightly exceeds XFreq by 0.01 dB in PSNR and 0.001 in SSIM.
blocks.zh:
表1列出了XFreq和有代表性的古典、每卷装配以及FetalBrain和CETUS的受监督方法的重建结果。
XFreq在大多数评价环境中都实现了最高的PSNR和3D SSIM,显示出各解剖结构和采样密度的强重建性能.
在以N=8 N=8为单位的CETUS上,C 2 RV-US在PSNR和SSIM中分别比XFreq小于0.01分贝.

blocks.en:
Increasing the number of input slices generally improves reconstruction accuracy across the evaluated methods.
However, BIGUS [ 1 ] , which relies on structure-aware Gaussian initialization and error-guided densification, shows non-monotonic performance on FetalBrain , with PSNR decreasing from N = 16 N=16 to N = 32 N=32 .
Among supervised methods, XFreq achieves the largest improvements, gaining 2.86 dB on FetalBrain and 4.30 dB on CETUS .
Compared with C 2 RV-US, the PSNR advantage of XFreq increases from 0.06 to 0.25 and 0.38 dB on FetalBrain as N N increases.
A similar increasing trend is observed on CETUS .
These results suggest XFreq makes more effective use of input slices than C 2 RV-US, consistent with its geometry-aligned cross-view feature integration design.

增加输入片数,一般提高被评价方法的重建精度.
然而,BIGUS [1]依靠结构感知高斯初始化和错误导出密度,在FetalBrain上表现出了非摩诺能性能,PSNR从N=16N=16下降到N=32N=32.
在受监督的方法中,XFreq取得了最大的改进,在FetalBrain上获得了2.86分贝,在CETUS上获得了4.30分贝.
与C 2 RV-US相比,随着NN的增加,XFreq在FetalBrain上的PSNR优势从0.06增加到了0.25和0.38 dB.
CETUS也有类似的增长趋势。
这些结果表明XFreq比C 2 RV-US更有效地使用输入片,这与其几何相通的交叉视图特征集成设计是一致的.

blocks.en:
To assess the effect of data consistency (DC), we compare supervised methods with and without the same frozen correction in Table 1 .
DC improves both PSNR and SSIM across the two datasets and all sampling densities, with larger gains for NConv-CNN-3D and DIF-Net-US than for XFreq and C 2 RV-US.
As these metrics are evaluated on unobserved voxels, the improvements indicate that the spatially regularized correction benefits regions beyond the observed slices.
Even without DC, XFreq outperforms C 2 RV-US at N = 32 N=32 by 0.40 and 0.31 dB on FetalBrain and CETUS , respectively.
These results suggest that DC provides a useful refinement across methods, while the performance advantage of XFreq is already present before correction.

由于这些衡量标准是在未观测到的阴道上评估的,因此改进表明,空间规范化的校正在观测到的片段之外有好处。
即使没有DC,XFreq在FetalBrain和CETUS上的C2 RV-US在N=32 N=32上分别以0.40和0.31 dB超越.
这些结果表明,DC对各种方法进行了有益的改进,而XFreq的性能优势在纠正之前已经存在。

We evaluate queried 2D image features through two ablations in Table 2 .
The w/o Queried Features variant replaces the queried 2D CNN features with zeros before aggregation, while w/o Local Querying replaces them with globally pooled features.
Both variants preserve all other components and training settings.
The performance gains indicate that queried image features improve PSNR and SSIM in most settings.
The PSNR gains increase with the number of input slices on both datasets, suggesting that additional observations provide richer spatial context for feature querying.
At N = 8 N=8 , queried features provide no consistent improvement on FetalBrain , whereas CETUS still benefits from queried features under the same sampling budget.
This difference suggests that the effectiveness of queried features depends on both anatomy and sampling density.
Replacing local queries with globally pooled features generally reduces PSNR, particularly at higher sampling densities, highlighting the importance of spatial correspondence beyond feature content alone.

在N=8 N=8中,被询问的特征并不能持续改善FetalBrain,而CETUS仍受益于同一抽样预算下的被询问特征。
这种差异表明被询问特征的有效性取决于解剖学和采样密度.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented XFreq, a framework for reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D slices with known poses.
XFreq combines splatted intensities and finite slice geometry with locally queried 2D features, using a gated residual decoder to refine volumetric predictions.
Experiments on fetal brain and cardiac ultrasound datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across different numbers of input slices.
Ablation studies show that queried features and finite slice geometry improve reconstruction quality, with queried features providing larger gains near observed slices.
Building on our evaluation with 2D slices resampled from 3D volumes, future work will explore extending XFreq to independently acquired ultrasound scans under varying acquisition conditions and assessing its potential for clinically relevant anatomical applications.

胎儿脑和心脏超声波数据集的实验显示,不同数量输入片段的重建性能很强.

根据我们用从3D卷重印的2D切片进行的评价,今后的工作将探索将XFreq扩展至在不同获取条件下独立获得的超声波扫描,并评估其临床相关解剖应用的潜力.
